Sandbox_TGI_SearchEnabled_tooltip: Items in containers are hidden until searched
Sandbox_TGI_ScatterLoot_tooltip: Items in containers are placed randomly
Sandbox_TGI_HideBagContents_tooltip: Bag tooltips do not reveal unsearched contents
Sandbox_TGI_InterruptRadius_tooltip: Searching stops when a zombie is closer. 0 = off
Sandbox_TGI_BackpackOnRun_tooltip: Worn backpack can't be used while running or sprinting
Sandbox_TGI_TransferSpeedByPlace_tooltip: Rig is faster, fanny pack a bit faster, backpack slower
Sandbox_TGI_StashChance_tooltip: Chance a container is a stash with rare loot
Sandbox_TGI_LockChance_tooltip: Cabinets, safes and lockers in houses may be locked: needs the house key, a crowbar or a screwdriver
Sandbox_TGI_SearchXPMult_tooltip: How fast the Searching skill levels up. 0 = no XP, 1 = normal, 2 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_TGI_SearchPerks_tooltip: Level bonuses of the Searching skill (hints, stash detection, quiet search, valuables first, rarity, +25%% speed). The skill itself still speeds up searching.
Sandbox_TGI_DangerSearchSpeed_tooltip: Searching slows down as panic rises. This is the speed at full panic. 0 = searching stops, 1 = no penalty.
Sandbox_TGI_AllowNoSearch_tooltip: Lets each player skip item search with their own Mod Options switch
Sandbox_TGI_CellsPerWeight_tooltip: How many grid cells one unit of a container's capacity gives. 2.5 = default.
Sandbox_TGI_MaxContainerCells_tooltip: Upper limit for any container's grid (for servers with raised capacities). 0 = no limit.
